decisions.reason: Since the standalone shuttering robot was dropped, the combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot likely now carries that function, so its option value has risen even though two years of evidence leave its market value still uncertain.
The de-shuttering robot shares engineering with the combined robot and costs little to keep, but it may eventually be absorbed into the combined unit as the line consolidates.
The profile storage robot complements the shuttering cells at low marginal cost and supports the integrated automation offer, so the option stays open.
The combined magazining, cleaning and plotting line was launched only in 2024 with several models, so its uncertainty is high and it fits the core circulation-plant offer.
The production analysis software is new, cheap to maintain and supports the firm's digital lifecycle-service strategy, so abandoning it would be premature.
